name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: A government-backed, one-year renewable term life insurance scheme offering affordable life cover to bank account holders, providing financial protection to nominees in case of the insured's death due to any cause.
benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh paid to the nominee if the insured person dies during the active policy period, for any reason (natural, illness, or accident), at a nominal annual premium of Rs. 436, auto-debited from the subscriber's bank account. Renewable every year; policy can be withdrawn anytime.
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged 18 to 50 years
Must hold a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent
No medical examination or documentation required to join
Coverage available up to age 55, subject to annual renewal and premium payment
how_to_apply: Apply through your bank's net banking or mobile banking app, or visit the bank branch/post office, select PMJJBY, provide account and nominee details, and give consent for annual auto-debit of the premium.
